t.zh: 只写函数名的、有陷阱的、只说症状的，一块板全部接住。
t.en: Named by function, with a trap, or only a symptom: one board takes them all.

after.zh: 一块板接住了三种 issue：要目录、读文件、跑测试、改到通过。这就是一个完整的编码 agent：一个循环，一个上下文，几个工具，一道检查。
after.en: One board took all three kinds: list, read, test, fix until it passes. That is a whole coding agent: a loop, a context, a few tools and a check.

brief.zh: 三种 issue 混在一起，每个都要在 10 轮内改好并停下。
brief.en: Three kinds of issue mixed, each fixed and stopped within 10 turns.
